change: Diagnose and reduce native geometry startup cost

environment.gpu: ANGLE (AMD, ANGLE Metal Renderer: AMD Radeon Pro 5300M, Unspecified Version)

notes: Worker CPU sums overlap network and main-thread work; they are not additive navigation stages.
The exact cause of the historical 54.65-second sample is not established; request interception and disabled cache did not reproduce it.

implementation.gzip: Native construction programs only; no prebuilt meshes
implementation.packing: Vite startup/build and the optional procedural author compiler
implementation.retained: Every construction instruction, both LODs, animation, geometry, routes and collision rules

productionAB.transport: Static production build under /hikone-traffic-sim/; compression decoded by the worker; cache disabled; same Chrome page, 1280x720 high quality. Controlled mode caps model-body writes at 100 Mbps, other files unthrottled.

checks: walking: start, traffic, debug contact, replay views/restart/end, results, menu
bicycle: start, traffic, debug contact, replay views/restart/end, results, menu
static editor: 10 browser templates, map/detail image, cycling template validation

limits: Two samples per A/B condition; the same desktop Chrome page, cache disabled, fixed 1280x720 high quality, A-B-B-A order.
100 Mbps limits model response bodies only; other files are unthrottled. This is controlled server delivery, not a physical phone/network measurement.
The historical 55-second sample is not the baseline for the improvement claim.
Two workers can increase peak construction memory; real-phone memory/performance remains unmeasured.
Window resource/heap entries exclude worker work; model payload bytes here come from the static server writer.
